criteria.criterion: In crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs, each athena-cli-reachable reader (Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, introspect walks, scoring, forecasting, retry carry, auditor, proposals, backtest) has a named worktree test planting different records in the worktree and in-tree and asserting the worktree's are returned. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: Every named worktree_<reader> test exists and passes (26/26 in my run), and each plants W in the worktree and T in-tree. However, worktree_scoring (lines 262-267) has the same body as worktree_records_load_current: it calls Records::load_current and never runs the scoring closures in run.rs or manage.rs. worktree_introspect_walks only checks records_root and does not run Athena::introspect. worktree_backtest calls read_records_current, not backtest::run. worktree_proposals asserts on a read_records_current call the test makes itself, not on what propose read. Reverting those production call sites would leave these tests green, so for these four readers the test does not show the reader returning the worktree's records.

criteria.criterion: Each of those readers has a named fallback test with no worktree asserting in-tree records/ is returned, equal to the pre-change result. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: Every fallback_<reader> test passed and asserts T is returned and W is not. fallback_equals_the_unchanged_loaders compares load_current with load, and RecordSet file bytes, at head. fallback_scoring_honours_passed_head checks that load_current equals load at an older commit. The same weakness as criterion 1 applies to the scoring, introspect, backtest and proposals fallbacks, but here the fallback path is the unchanged loader.

criteria.criterion: xtask's own tests contain worktree_walltime and fallback_walltime (not in the athena-cli test file) plus a linked-worktree test finding the records worktree via git's common dir. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked and confirm a nonzero number of tests ran.
criteria.evidence: 40 unit tests ran, including walltime::tests::worktree_walltime, fallback_walltime and linked_worktree_walltime, all passing. The linked test adds a git worktree whose .git is a file and asserts that current_root (via Git::common_dir) returns W.

criteria.criterion: land_pr tests (in gh.rs, where Rig/FakeHost are reachable) use distinct job ids in worktree and in-tree records: resolve succeeds for the worktree-only id and fails with 'unknown job' for the in-tree-only id; under fallback the reverse. Run cargo test --locked land_pr.
criteria.evidence: gh::records_source_tests::worktree_land_pr and fallback_land_pr passed. They use the distinct ids ...-wwww and ...-tttt and call Athena::land_pr with a runner that refuses every host call. The resolved id fails later with 'has no verification'; the other id fails with 'no job matches'; the fallback test asserts the reverse. The wording is 'no job matches' rather than 'unknown job', and the accepted plan noted this. They use make_athena and a refusing Runner rather than Rig/FakeHost, which still meets the criterion's intent.

criteria.criterion: A test runs the built athena binary's status, audit and a forecast on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/; worktree and in-tree records have distinct job ids, and status and audit output contain the worktree's id and not the in-tree one; all succeed. Run cargo test --locked.

It runs the built `athena status`, `athena audit W` and `athena ask` (the forecast, with a stand-in claude). It asserts each exits 0, that status and audit stdout contain W and not T, and that `audit T` fails with 'no job matches'.

findings.summary: The scoring tests never run the scoring code; reverting run.rs or manage.rs would leave them passing.
findings.evidence: worktree_scoring, fallback_scoring and scoring_ignores_passed_head call only Records::load_current, the same code as the records_load_current tests. The closures `score_on` in run.rs (close_dispatched) and `commit_records_in` in manage.rs are not run. The accepted plan said 'A closure honouring the passed head returns main's records and the test fails', which is false here. This breaks the behavior-evidence default and criteria 1 and 6.

findings.summary: The introspect, backtest and proposals worktree tests check helper functions, not the readers.
findings.evidence: introspect_walks only checks records_root and never runs Athena::introspect. backtest calls the re-exported read_records_current, not backtest::run. proposals asserts on a read_records_current call the test makes after propose, so propose's own reads are not observed. Reverting the call sites in introspect.rs, backtest.rs or proposals.rs would leave these tests green.

findings.summary: Reads now come from the worktree, but writes still go to the checkout.
findings.evidence: D134 states that once a worktree exists, a command such as `priority` reads the worktree and commits its record to the checkout. So `athena ask` followed by `athena go <id>` could fail to resolve the job it just wrote. Nothing in the base code creates the worktree yet, so this cannot happen today, but the writers need to move before a worktree is created.

findings.summary: Two expected deliverables were not changed.
findings.evidence: A grep for Records::load(, RecordSet::load(, read_records( and read_jobs( finds no readers in either file. The list came from the earlier job, and audit.rs was not in the plan, so leaving them unchanged is harmless.

summary: The production change is correct. Every listed reader now calls `load_current`, `read_records_current` or `current_root`. These read the athena/records worktree under the state directory when it exists, and otherwise read the in-tree records/ or the given commit as before. All 26 tests in records_branch_readers, all 40 xtask unit tests (including the walltime and records_reader_scan tests) and the two land_pr tests in gh.rs ran and passed for me. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed, and site.rs is unchanged. The verdict is fail because four of the per-reader tests in the athena-cli file never run the reader they are named for: scoring, introspect_walks, proposals and backtest. worktree_scoring and scoring_ignores_passed_head only call `Records::load_current`, the same code as worktree_records_load_current. If the scoring closures in run.rs or manage.rs were put back to `Records::load(head)`, every test would still pass. That is exactly the failure the plan said these tests would catch. In the same way, the introspect test only checks `records_root`, the backtest test calls `read_records_current` directly instead of `backtest::run`, and the proposals test reads `read_records_current` itself after `propose` returns. This breaks the behavior-evidence default and criteria 1 and 6. Separately, the snapshot has no change description (the commit message is just "candidate"), so I could not check criterion 9.
